_why: Two implementations of one policy, run over one list. forge/src/series.js decides what may be recorded on Forge; scripts/serve_live.py decides it over loopback. Neither is arithmetic — the figures all come from agent/tools/metrics.py — but a policy that differed between transports would mean a sprint recorded down one route and reconstructed down the other, with the page saying different things about the same board depending on how it was reached. ADR 0009, ADR 0015.
